candidate: AVAIO Digital Leo (Project Leo) AI-ready data center and power campus, 145th Street, unincorporated Pulaski County near Little Rock, Arkansas
decision: Selected the centroid (computed in UTM 15N on WGS 84) of the union of the three contiguous Pulaski County tax parcels owned by ADP LITTLE ROCK DATA HUB LLC (35R-024.00-023.00 and 35R-019.00-068.00 at E 145th St, and 35R-024.13-001.00 at McDonald Rd, which the first parcel encloses), as published in the Arkansas GIS Office statewide parcel layer, as the campus locator. AVAIO's own published campus coordinate (34.623375, -92.246825) falls inside parcel 35R-024.00-023.00 and inside the union, 291 m north-north-east of the selected point.
layer: Arkansas GIS Office, FEATURESERVICES/Planning_Cadastre FeatureServer layer 6 PARCEL_POLYGON_CAMP (statewide publication of county assessor tax parcels; Pulaski County CAMA record date 2026-09-11, publication date 2026-10-01; native CRS NAD83 / UTM zone 15N, EPSG:26915)

excluded_properties.35R-013.00-015.00 and 35R-013.00-016.00: Owned by ADP LITTLE ROCK GREEN COMPUTE LLC (German Rd and Mona Ln, section 13, 19.64 and 19.85 geodesic acres, 626 to 800 m north-west of the operator point). A separately named entity; neither AVAIO source ties these parcels to the 296-acre Leo campus, so they are not part of the locator.

method: Polygons returned with outSR=4326. Esri ring orientation was honoured (clockwise outer rings, counter-clockwise holes). The union centroid was computed in UTM zone 15N (EPSG:32615) with pyproj 3.7.1 and shapely 2.1.1 and transformed back to WGS 84; geodesic areas on the WGS 84 ellipsoid. Cross-check: the same three parcels requested in the native EPSG:26915 coordinates give a union centroid 0.91 m from the selected point.

operator_point_check.reading: Page text 'Latitude & Longitude 34.623375 -92.246825' and JSON-LD GeoCoordinates latitude 34.623375, longitude -92.246825 (identical in the Internet Archive copies of 18 June, 19 August and 4 September 2026)
operator_point_check.point_query_result: a point-intersect query of the parcel layer at the operator coordinate returns only 35R-024.00-023.00, ADP LITTLE ROCK DATA HUB LLC, E 145TH ST

jurisdiction_check.municipal_result: no MUNICIPAL_BOUNDARY polygon (Arkansas GIS Office Boundaries layer 41) contains the operator point: unincorporated area

interpretation: The three parcels form one contiguous 290-acre property owned by ADP LITTLE ROCK DATA HUB LLC on East 145th Street; AVAIO (AVAIO Digital Partners) describes Leo as a 296-acre project on 145th Street in Pulaski County and publishes a campus coordinate that falls inside this property. The selected point is the centroid of the whole parcel union and locates the campus property, not a building, a works extent or a surveyed boundary.
datum_note: The parcel layer is natively NAD83 / UTM 15N; the WGS 84 output and the native cross-check differ by 0.91 m. AVAIO publishes no datum for its coordinate.
alternatives_rejected: AVAIO's published coordinate is used only as an identity cross-check: it is a first-party pin without datum or method, while the official parcels locate the whole campus property.

Pulaski Area GIS (www.pagis.org) did not answer its robots.txt request (connection timeout), so it was not used; the Arkansas GIS Office statewide parcel publication of the Pulaski County records was used instead.
The U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder was in an outage (requests redirected to outage.census.gov) and was not used.
The ADP LITTLE ROCK GREEN COMPUTE LLC parcels in section 13 are excluded (see excluded_properties).
No OpenStreetMap, Nominatim, city centroid or county centroid was used.
